summary.text: Crit alert: Spindle 3 temperature reached 64.2, which is 4.2 over the 60 °C validated limit (PS-TM-MILL-HS-003 rev C). Lot TM-HS12-261120-189 has 3 parts at risk. The alert is still open. The rule requires a QA hold, an NCR and CMM inspection.

quarantine.rationale: These 3 parts were cut while Spindle 3 was outside its validated limit. The rule requires a QA hold on them. The lot row lists the other 12 parts as releasable, subject to QA decision.

cmm_inspection.scope: CMM-inspect stem taper and neck geometry on the 3 at-risk parts of lot TM-HS12-261120-189 (DHR-TM-HS12-261120-189) before any move to CLEAN / PASSIVATE.

ncr.rationale: The rule requires an NCR for parts machined outside the validated limit (60 °C, reading 64.2). Use NCR-20261120-154724-C6EF, the NCR id given on the alert row, for lot TM-HS12-261120-189.

maintenance_request.rationale: Crit thermal excursion on Spindle 3. The last spindle bearing inspection was 2026-09-01, when thermal compensation was re-verified per OQ-TM-CNC1-014. Request a maintenance investigation and re-verification.

risk_narrative.text: The model risk score is 0.87 (87%), model version 3, labelled synthetic. The largest drivers are the 5-minute spindle temperature slope (contribution 0.41) and vibration RMS (0.22). Projected right-first-time is 70.0% (7 good of 10 started); no CMM results exist yet.

steps.action: Review and sign the quarantine of lot TM-HS12-261120-189, in particular the 3 at-risk parts listed in the disposition (DHR-TM-HS12-261120-189, WO-TM-24817).
Open NCR NCR-20261120-154724-C6EF. Cite the 60 °C validated limit, the 64.2 reading, PS-TM-MILL-HS-003 rev C, PQ-TM-HS12-022 and OQ-TM-CNC1-014.
Request CMM inspection of stem taper and neck geometry on the 3 at-risk parts. Keep them out of CLEAN / PASSIVATE until a qualified person has signed the results.
Investigate Spindle 3 overheating and re-verify thermal compensation. The last inspection of this component was 2026-09-01.
Do not resume Spindle 3 cutting on HS-TI64-12 until the temperature is confirmed back below 60 °C. The last bucket still read 61.0 to 63.1 and the alert is not cleared.
Confirm which cuts overlapped the excursion. Reconcile parts_started of 10 in the projected RFT row with the 15 parts per lot in the lot row. Alert event history was unavailable.
After the CMM results, QA decides on the remaining 12 releasable parts and the dispositions of the 3 at-risk parts in the NCR. A qualified person signs all decisions.
